title: What is the Last Mile Data (LMD) Portal 2.0?
value: LMD 2.0 is a next-generation, cloud-based data management and reporting platform developed by Last Mile Health (LMH). It is designed to improve data collection, storage, and analytics to support decision-making across multiple countries and programs.

title: Why was LMD 2.0 developed?
value: LMD 2.0 was developed to address the limitations of LMD 1.0, which was built on older technologies that required extensive programming and lacked scalability. With LMH expanding globally, there was a need for a more flexible, scalable, and cost-effective platform to manage diverse data sources and support real-time analytics.

title: What are the key differences between LMD 1.0 and LMD 2.0?
value:
• LMD 1.0 was built for low-bandwidth environments but required significant development efforts. It also lacked scalability as it was hosted on a private VPS.
  • LMD 2.0 is cloud-based, more scalable, and designed to handle data from multiple countries while providing advanced analytics and reporting capabilities.

title: How does LMD 2.0 improve data management for LMH?
value:
LMD 2.0 enhances data management by:

  • Enabling real-time data collection and reporting.
  • Providing a scalable infrastructure that can support LMH's expanding global operations.
  • Offering a richer user experience for data analysts and program managers.
  • Improving integration with various data sources for better tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs).

title: What challenges did LMH face with data management before LMD 2.0?
value:
LMH faced challenges such as:

  • Managing data from multiple sources and formats.
  • Difficulty in scaling LMD 1.0 to support new country programs.
  • High costs associated with maintaining and expanding the old system.
  • Limited ability to generate actionable insights from collected data.

title: How does LMD 2.0 help in making data-driven decisions?
value: LMD 2.0 provides advanced analytics and reporting capabilities that allow LMH to track program performance more accurately. The platform aggregates data from different sources and presents insights in a structured format, enabling program managers and policymakers to make informed decisions.

title: What are the benefits of moving to a cloud-based system?
value:
Moving to the cloud allows LMH to:

  • Scale efficiently as data needs grow.
  • Reduce maintenance and infrastructure costs.
  • Improve system reliability and security.
  • Enable better collaboration across multiple countries and teams.

title: What countries will benefit from LMD 2.0?
value: LMD 2.0 supports LMH's global programs, including operations in Liberia, Ethiopia, Malawi, Sierra Leone, Uganda, and other countries where LMH is actively working to strengthen community health systems.

title: What are the long-term goals of LMD 2.0?
value:
The long-term goals of LMD 2.0 include:

  • Providing a sustainable and scalable platform for LMH's growing data needs.
  • Enhancing real-time monitoring, evaluation, and learning across programs.
  • Improving data quality and accessibility to support informed decision-making.
  • Supporting LMH's mission to bring high-quality primary healthcare to remote communities.

title: Who can access and use LMD 2.0?
value: LMD 2.0 is primarily designed for LMH staff, data analysts, program managers, and policymakers involved in monitoring and evaluating community health programs. The platform may also integrate with partner organizations to facilitate data sharing and reporting.
